name: Unprepared Combatant
body:
Source Ultimate Magic pg. 246
School enchantment (compulsion) [emotion, mind-affecting]; Level arcanist 1, bard 1, medium 1, mesmerist 1, psychic 1, skald 1, sorcerer 1, witch 1, wizard 1
Casting
Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S
Effect
Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 minute/level
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes
Description
The target takes a –4 penalty on initiative checks and Reflex saves.
